summary: AI engineer with four years shipping production LLM and agentic systems end to end, working directly with stakeholders to turn fuzzy problems into working AI. I build tool-calling agents, RAG and retrieval over messy data, prompt and output-guardrail design, evaluation and monitoring — owning delivery from prototype to production. Strong Python, LangChain/LangGraph, APIs and PostgreSQL.

bullets: Owned the full AI feature lifecycle in production: architecture, retrieval and prompt design, output validation, deployment, and monitoring.
Built an LLM-powered agent that retrieves domain data to generate recommendations and guidance for users.
Designed retrieval, prompt, and output-guardrail layers for a production system, evaluating output for correctness and reliability.
Built the retrieval and data layer (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis); improved data-access performance by **30%** for high-frequency inference calls.
Built an AI platform with LangChain and RAG pipelines, normalizing third-party data and retrieving context for personalized outputs.
Developed an AI Virtual Trainer agent with agentic reasoning and personalization, increasing user engagement by **40%**; owned design to deployment.
Built SmartMedHx (Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL), applying LLM extraction to automate workflows.
Engineered a streaming LLM renderer achieving **98%** rendering accuracy.
Built a platform from zero to **$1M+ revenue**, owning backend infrastructure, data models, and scalable APIs across **3,200+ brands** and **190+ countries**.
Delivered features end to end with remote stakeholders; improved backend performance by **25%** through query optimization and caching.
